provenance: AuthZReq payloads recorded verbatim from dockerd 29.9.0 (API 1.56) started with --userns-remap=default and an allow-all recording plugin, driven over tcp by Docker CLI 29.9.0, compose v5.6.0 and buildx v0.38.0 from the docker:29.9.0-dind image. Only RequestHeaders were trimmed to Content-Type and User-Agent; identical requests are deduplicated. Each session lists requests in the order dockerd sent them.
